particlefilter.title: Particle Filter
particlefilter.settings.title: Particle Filter settings
particlefilter.settings.walk: Walk while the menu is open
particlefilter.settings.walk.description: Move, jump and sneak with your usual keys while a Particle Filter screen is open, to walk around what you're scanning or see a zone from another side. Not while you're typing in a box. To sprint, close the menu.
particlefilter.settings.tracers.descript: Draws a line from your crosshair to the center of each zone, in the zone's outline color, whenever outlines show: while the menu is open, or with Always Show Zone Outlines. The lines show through blocks, so you can find zones out of sight.
particlefilter.back.tooltip: Back to the previous menu (or press Esc)
particlefilter.mode.title: Active rules
particlefilter.mode.all.tooltip: Everything you've hidden is hidden: everywhere and in zones.
particlefilter.mode.everywhere.tooltip: Only what you've hidden everywhere stays hidden, including everything made from blocks you hid. Zones are paused.
particlefilter.mode.zones.tooltip: Only particles hidden in zones stay hidden. Everywhere rules are paused.
particlefilter.mode.none.tooltip: Nothing is hidden, so you can compare with and without your rules. Your rules are kept.
particlefilter.paused.tooltip: Saved but not applied while Active rules is set to "%s"
particlefilter.particle.untyped.tooltip:
%s
This particle was created by a mod without a particle type, so it is matched by its class name
particlefilter.scan.title: Scan
particlefilter.scan.button.tooltip: Records every particle that spawns within %s blocks of what you're looking at for %s seconds, including those your rules already hide
particlefilter.scan.status_idle: Find out which particles are on screen
particlefilter.scan.status_done_hidden: %s particle types found around %s; your rules already hide %s of them
particlefilter.scan.empty_first: Look at the particles, then press Scan
particlefilter.scan.empty_first.body: Aim at where the unwanted particles come from (a block, mob, farm, or just the area around you). Every particle that spawns within %s blocks over the next %s seconds is listed here, including those your rules already hide, so you don't need to know its name.
particlefilter.scan.empty_running.body: Recording every particle within %s blocks. The game keeps running, so keep the particles coming.
particlefilter.scan.empty_none.body: Nothing appeared within %s blocks during the scan. Try again while the particles are showing.
particlefilter.scan.zone.tooltip: Hide %s only inside zone "%s", named below the list
particlefilter.scan.zone_existing.toolti: Switching on Here hides the particle in zone "%s" (%s, %s), which contains or touches the scanned block. Press New zones to hide particles in new zones fitted to where they appeared instead.
particlefilter.scan.zone_new: Here: new zones, fitted to where each particle appeared (cyan)
particlefilter.scan.duration.tooltip: How long a scan records, %s-%s seconds. Shift-click − or + to step by 10
particlefilter.scan.radius.tooltip: How far from what you're looking at a scan records, %s-%s blocks. Minecraft usually doesn't create particles more than 32 blocks from you, so that's as far as it goes.
particlefilter.scan.zone_fitted.tooltip: Switching on Here makes a zone for each source of that particle: the spots where it appeared during this scan (or, if your rules hid it, where it spawned), grouped when they're close together. A particle gets zones for its busiest sources, and zones that overlap enough merge into one box around both; Zone options above the list set all three. Zones keep adjusting as you switch particles on and off or change Zone options, until you move or resize one yourself or scan again. Each side is at most %s blocks; a source spread wider is only partly covered, so consider Everywhere for it.
particlefilter.scan.grow_notice: "%s" hides %s, but it also appeared outside that zone
particlefilter.scan.here_new.tooltip: Hide particles from this scan in new zones instead, fitted to where each one appeared
particlefilter.scan.here_use.tooltip: Hide particles from this scan in zone "%s" instead
particlefilter.scan.edit_zone.tooltip: Move, resize or rename the zone Here uses. With new zones, this works once the scan has made exactly one; the Zones page lists them all
particlefilter.scan.zone_made: Here: %s zones made by this scan
particlefilter.scan.zone_made_one: Here: 1 zone made by this scan
particlefilter.scan.zone_capped: A zone hit the size limit and misses some spawn points; hover for details
particlefilter.scan.here_fitted.tooltip: Hide %s in zones fitted to where it appeared, one per source (hover the row to see them)
particlefilter.scan.many_sources: %s appeared in %s separate places; Here covers the %s busiest. Everywhere may suit it better.
particlefilter.scan.row_mixed: %s appeared and %s were hidden, spawning within %s
particlefilter.scan.hidden_by_changed: a rule you have since changed
particlefilter.scan.options.tooltip: Settings for the zones Here makes: how far apart spots can be and still count as one source, how many zones one particle gets, and how much zones must overlap to merge. While open, the number beside each Here switch says how many zones it hides that particle in.
particlefilter.scan.source_distance.tool: Spots where a particle appeared count as one source when they're at most this many blocks apart, directly or through spots in between. Here makes one zone per source, and Grow to fit takes in spots this close to a zone. %s-%s blocks. Shift-click − or + to step by 10
particlefilter.scan.max_zones.tooltip: Most zones Here makes for one particle, for its busiest sources. A particle with more sources gets a notice suggesting Everywhere. %s-%s. Shift-click − or + to step by 10
particlefilter.scan.merge.tooltip: Two zones made by Here merge into one box around both when at least this share of the smaller one overlaps the other. At 100%% only a zone lying entirely inside another merges; lower values merge more, and the merged box can also cover space neither did. At 0%% zones that touch face to face merge too, even sharing no blocks. Zones never merge past %s blocks a side. Zones follow the slider as you drag it.
particlefilter.grow.tooltip: Grow "%s" from %s to %s so it also covers every spot where they appeared. It never gets smaller. Hover the notice to see the new outline.
particlefilter.grow.capped: Each side is at most %s blocks, so some spots stay outside.
particlefilter.hidden.title: Hidden
particlefilter.hidden.subtitle: Everything you've hidden, and where
particlefilter.hidden.add_particle.toolt: Hide this particle everywhere (or press Enter). Takes a particle type ID, mod:* for every particle of a mod, or particle@block for a particle made from a block, where the block can be mod:* or #tag. Red text isn't a valid ID.
particlefilter.hidden.add_block.tooltip: Hide everything made from this block everywhere: breaking, mining and dust particles. Takes a block ID, mod:* for every block of a mod, or #tag for the blocks in a tag.
particlefilter.hidden.empty.body: Use Scan to find the particles you want gone, or type an ID above.
particlefilter.zones.title: Zones
particlefilter.zones.subtitle: Areas where chosen particles are hidden
particlefilter.zones.empty: No zones in this world yet
particlefilter.zones.empty.body: Scan somewhere and switch on Here, or create a zone around you with New zone.
particlefilter.zones.new.tooltip: Creates a 9 × 5 × 9 zone around you, with its bottom 2 blocks below your feet
particlefilter.zones.always_show.tooltip: Show zone outlines in the world, not just while this menu is open
particlefilter.zone.title: Edit zone
particlefilter.zone.name: Name
particlefilter.zone.center_x.tooltip: X coordinate of the zone's center
particlefilter.zone.bottom_y.tooltip: Y coordinate of the zone's lowest layer
particlefilter.zone.center_z.tooltip: Z coordinate of the zone's center
particlefilter.zone.height.tooltip: Height of the zone in blocks, %s-%s. Shift-click − or + to step by 10
particlefilter.zone.center_on_me.tooltip: Center the zone on where you stand, with its bottom at your feet
Center the zone on the block you were looking at when you opened the menu
particlefilter.zone.hides_nothing: Nothing yet. Scan inside this zone and switch on Here.
particlefilter.zone.side1.tooltip: Length of the zone along X (east-west) in blocks, %s-%s. Shift-click − or + to step by 10
particlefilter.zone.side2.tooltip: Length of the zone along Z (north-south) in blocks, %s-%s. Shift-click − or + to step by 10
particlefilter.zone.delete.tooltip: Delete the zone and everything hidden in it (click twice)
particlefilter.outlines.off: Zone outlines: only in the menu
particlefilter.block.hidden_paused: Breaking particles hidden for %s (paused while Active rules is "%s")
particlefilter.block.by_rule: %s is hidden by a wildcard or tag entry; change it on the Hidden page
particlefilter.entry.switch.tooltip: On: hidden. Off: shown again, but kept in the list to switch back on
particlefilter.guide.title: Quick start
particlefilter.guide.scan.title: Find the particles
particlefilter.guide.scan.body: Look at where the unwanted particles come from and press Scan. Every particle that spawns nearby during the scan is listed, those still appearing first, so you don't need to know any names; dimmed rows are ones your rules already hide. Set how long it records next to "Scan for", and how far with Radius. Particles made from a block, like breaking debris, get a row per block.
particlefilter.guide.hide.title: Hide them
particlefilter.guide.hide.body: Switch on Everywhere to hide a particle in every world, or Here to hide it only around the scanned spot. The line under the list says where Here hides it. In new zones, each source of the particle gets its own zone, sized to fit where it appeared; hover a row to see them. If there's already a zone at the scanned spot, Here uses that one; New zones switches back. If a zone hides a particle that still appears just outside it, Grow to fit offers to enlarge it. Zone options above the list set how far apart spots can be and still count as one source, how many zones one particle gets, and how much zones must overlap to merge, and show the number of zones beside each Here switch.
particlefilter.guide.hidden.title: Hidden page
particlefilter.guide.hidden.body: Everything you've hidden, and where. Switch an entry off to see the particle again without losing it; Delete removes it. You can also type a particle ID, or hide a block's breaking and mining particles.
particlefilter.guide.zones.title: Zones
particlefilter.guide.zones.body: Each zone has its own outline color, shown while this menu is open. Edit a zone to move or resize it; Side 1 and Side 2 are labelled with the way they run from where you face.
particlefilter.guide.rules.title: Active rules
particlefilter.guide.rules.body: The switch at the bottom left pauses some or all of your rules at once, to compare with and without them. Nothing is deleted.
particlefilter.guide.keys.title: Keys
particlefilter.guide.keys.body: Keys to open this menu, scan, hide the targeted block's breaking particles, show zone outlines, cycle Active rules and hold to show every particle can be set in Options → Controls → Key Binds. They start unbound. Drag the menu's background to move it and its right or bottom edge to resize it; double-click the background to put it back. Config in the mod list has two more settings: walking while the menu is open, and lines from your crosshair to each zone.
